Penalty: Overall movement speed is reduced

cracked_charms.name: Zephyr

Benefit: Overall movement speed is increased
Penalty: Damage taken is increased

cracked_charms.name: Splintering Bolts
cracked_charms.text:
Benefit: Bolts shot from your wristbow do much more damage
Penalty: Bolts almost always break on contact when shot at enemies

cracked_charms.name: Shivering Silhouette
cracked_charms.text:
Benefit: Enemies have a high chance to miss ranged attacks
Penalty: You are more visible to enemies

cracked_charms.name: Statuesque
cracked_charms.text:

Penalty: Mana does not regenerate

cracked_charms.name: Power Slash
cracked_charms.text:
Benefit: You deal greater damage with your sword
Penalty: You swing your sword slower

cracked_charms.name: Witch's Skin
cracked_charms.text:
Benefit: When taking damage, your mana is drained before your health
Penalty: Mana does not regenerate

Penalty: Mana cost for Pull power is increased
